# BoomNetwork — Complete API Reference (for LLMs)

> This file contains everything an AI coding assistant needs to generate correct BoomNetwork multiplayer code.
> Read this file completely before generating code. Pay special attention to the "Common Mistakes" section.

---

## 1. FrameSyncClient — Primary Entry Point

Namespace: `BoomNetwork.Client.FrameSync`

### Constructor
```csharp
new FrameSyncClient(float heartbeatIntervalMs = 3000, float heartbeatTimeoutMs = 10000)
```

### State Machine
```
Disconnected → Connecting → Connected → InRoom → Syncing
                                                    ↕
                                              Reconnecting
```

### Properties (read-only)
```csharp
State  CurrentState          // current connection state
int    PlayerId              // assigned after SessionBind (0 = not assigned)
int    RoomId                // assigned after JoinRoom (0 = not in room)
uint   LastFrameNumber       // latest received frame
float  RttMs                 // round-trip time in ms (-1 if unmeasured)
FrameSyncInitData? InitData  // set after OnFrameSyncStart
bool   HasPreviousIdentity   // PlayerId > 0 && RoomId > 0 (for reconnect)
uint   SnapshotInterval      // frames between snapshots (default 100, overridden by server)
```

### Lifecycle Methods
```csharp
void Connect(string host, int port)       // start connection
void Tick(float deltaTimeMs)              // MUST call every frame in Update()
void Disconnect()                         // graceful disconnect, keeps identity for reconnect
void DisconnectAndClear()                 // disconnect + clear identity (no reconnect possible)
```

### Room Methods
```csharp
void GetRooms(Action<RoomInfo[]> onResult)           // list available rooms
void CreateRoom(int maxPlayers, Action<int>? cb)     // create and get roomId
void JoinRoom(int roomId)                            // join specific room
void CreateAndJoinRoom(int maxPlayers)               // create + join in one call
void MatchRoom(int maxPlayers, string? matchKey)     // auto-match: join existing or create new
void LeaveRoom()                                     // leave current room
```

### Frame Sync Methods
```csharp
void RequestStart()                                  // start frame sync (host calls this)
void RequestStop()                                   // stop frame sync
void SendInput(byte[] data, int dataLength = -1)     // send player input (also flushes entity states)
void SendAuthorityEntityStates()                     // send entity states without input
void SendFrameHash(uint frameNumber, uint hash)      // desync detection hash
```

### Entity Authority Methods
```csharp
void RegisterAuthorityEntity(IEntitySync entity)     // register owned entity (idempotent)
void UnregisterAuthorityEntity(int entityId)         // unregister owned entity
void RequestAuthorityTransfer(int entityId)          // request ownership of entity
void ReleaseAuthority(int entityId)                  // release ownership
```

### Lightweight State Sync (no frame sync needed)
```csharp
void SendStateMessage(byte[] data)                   // broadcast to room, not stored
void SetData(int key, byte[] value)                  // persistent KV, server stores + broadcasts
void DeleteData(int key)                             // delete KV entry
void RequestDataSync()                               // force full KV re-sync
void SendGameMessage(uint gameCmd, byte[] data)      // custom game message, server relays with senderPid
```

### Snapshot Callbacks (assign before Connect)
```csharp
Func<byte[]?>? OnTakeSnapshot     // framework calls this periodically; return serialized game state
Action<byte[]>? OnLoadSnapshot    // framework calls this on reconnect/late-join; restore game state
```

### Events
```csharp
// Connection lifecycle
event Action?                        OnConnected          // SessionBind success
event Action<int, int[]>?            OnJoinedRoom         // (roomId, existingPlayerIds)
event Action?                        OnReady              // unified: first join OR reconnect success
event Action?                        OnReconnected        // reconnect specifically succeeded
event Action?                        OnDisconnected       // connection lost
event Action<int>?                   OnLeftRoom           // (oldPlayerId)

// Frame sync
event Action<FrameSyncInitData>?     OnFrameSyncStart     // frame sync started, initData available
event Action<FrameData>?             OnFrame              // new frame received — process game logic here
event Action?                        OnFrameSyncStop      // frame sync stopped

// Player events (also delivered as FrameEvent inside OnFrame during sync)
event Action<int>?                   OnPlayerJoined       // (playerId)
event Action<int>?                   OnPlayerLeft         // (playerId)
event Action<int>?                   OnPlayerOffline      // (playerId) — temporary disconnect
event Action<int>?                   OnPlayerOnline       // (playerId) — reconnected
event Action<int>?                   OnHostChanged        // (newHostPlayerId)

// Entity authority
event Action<int,int,byte[],int,int>? OnEntityState      // (senderPid, entityId, data, offset, len)
event Action<int,int>?                OnAuthorityChanged  // (entityId, newOwnerPlayerId) 0=unclaimed

// Lightweight state sync
event Action<int, byte[]>?           OnStateMessage       // (playerId, data)
event Action<uint,int,int,byte[]>?   OnDataChanged        // (version, playerId, key, value)
event Action<uint, DataEntry[]>?     OnDataSynced         // (version, entries) full sync

// Custom game messages
event Action<uint,int,byte[],int>?   OnGameMessage        // (gameCmd, senderPid, data, offset)

// Diagnostics
event Action<NetworkError>?          OnError
event Action<string>?                OnLog
event Action?                        OnRateLimitWarning
event Action<FrameSyncPauseReason>?  OnFrameSyncPaused    // SnapshotStale=1, Desync=2
event Action?                        OnFrameSyncResumed
event Action<FrameHashMismatch>?     OnDesyncDetected
```

---

## 2. BoomNetworkManager — Unity MonoBehaviour Wrapper

Namespace: `BoomNetwork.Unity`

### Inspector Fields
```
host: string = "127.0.0.1"          // server address
port: int = 9000                     // server port
heartbeatIntervalMs: float = 3000
heartbeatTimeoutMs: float = 10000
maxPlayers: int = 4
autoStart: bool = true               // auto RequestStart after OnReady
matchKey: string = ""                // scopes matchmaking
logEnabled: bool = true
```

### Properties
```csharp
FrameSyncClient Client    // direct access to the underlying client
int PlayerId              // shortcut
bool IsConnected          // State >= Connected
bool IsSyncing            // State == Syncing
```

### Methods
```csharp
void Connect()                                   // uses Inspector host/port
void Connect(string serverHost, int serverPort)  // override
void Disconnect()
void SendInput(byte[] data, int dataLength = -1)
void QuickStart()   // Connect → MatchRoom → RequestStart (all automatic)
```

Note: BoomNetworkManager calls `client.Tick()` in its own `Update()`. Do NOT call Tick yourself.

---

## 3. Data Structures

```csharp
// Core frame data — received in OnFrame
struct FrameData {
    uint FrameNumber;
    PlayerInput[] Inputs;
    FrameEvent[] Events;   // player join/leave/offline/online/host change
}

struct PlayerInput {
    int PlayerId;
    byte[] Data;
    int DataLength;
    ReadOnlySpan<byte> DataSpan;   // zero-copy access (prefer this)
}

struct FrameEvent {
    byte EventType;   // 1=PlayerJoined, 2=PlayerLeft, 3=PlayerOffline, 4=PlayerOnline, 5=HostChanged
    int PlayerId;
}

// Init data — received in OnFrameSyncStart
struct FrameSyncInitData {
    int FrameRate;           // e.g. 20
    int FrameInterval;       // ms per frame, e.g. 50
    long StartTime;          // server timestamp
    int SnapshotInterval;    // frames between snapshots
    int QuickReconnectMaxMs; // quick reconnect window
}

// Room info
struct RoomInfo {
    int RoomId;
    int PlayerCount;
    int MaxPlayers;
    bool Running;       // frame sync active
    string MatchKey;
}

// Entity sync interface — implement for authority entities
interface IEntitySync {
    int EntityId { get; }
    int StateSize { get; }
    int WriteState(byte[] buffer, int offset);                                // authority: serialize state
    void OnRemoteState(byte[] data, int offset, int length, int senderPid);  // remote: apply state
}

// KV store entry
struct DataEntry {
    int PlayerId;
    int Key;
    byte[] Value;
}

// Desync detection
struct FrameHashMismatch {
    uint FrameNumber;
    (int PlayerId, uint Hash)[] PlayerHashes;
}

enum FrameSyncPauseReason : byte { SnapshotStale = 1, Desync = 2 }
```

---

## 4. Complete Code Templates

### Template A: Frame Sync Game (Action/MOBA/Survival)

```csharp
using BoomNetwork.Client.FrameSync;

public class FrameSyncGame {
    FrameSyncClient client;
    Dictionary<int, PlayerState> players = new();

    public void Init() {
        client = new FrameSyncClient();

        // Snapshot for reconnect + late-join
        client.OnTakeSnapshot = () => SerializeAllPlayers();
        client.OnLoadSnapshot = data => DeserializeAllPlayers(data);

        // Connection flow
        client.OnConnected      += () => client.MatchRoom(4, "my-game");
        client.OnReady          += () => client.RequestStart();
        client.OnFrameSyncStart += init => InitGame(init.FrameRate);

        // Frame processing — THE CORE LOOP
        client.OnFrame += frame => {
            // Process frame events first
            foreach (var evt in frame.Events) {
                switch (evt.EventType) {
                    case 1: SpawnPlayer(evt.PlayerId); break;    // PlayerJoined
                    case 2: RemovePlayer(evt.PlayerId); break;   // PlayerLeft
                    case 5: SetHost(evt.PlayerId); break;        // HostChanged
                }
            }
            // Process inputs — SKIP LOCAL PLAYER (Local-First)
            foreach (var input in frame.Inputs) {
                if (input.PlayerId == client.PlayerId) continue;
                ApplyInput(input.PlayerId, input.DataSpan);
            }
            // Advance game simulation (shared state update)
            TickGameLogic(frame.FrameNumber);
        };

        // Reconnect
        client.OnReconnected  += () => ResumeGame();
        client.OnDisconnected += () => ShowDisconnectUI();

        client.Connect("127.0.0.1", 9000);
    }

    // Called every frame (e.g. Unity Update)
    public void Update(float dtMs) {
        client.Tick(dtMs);

        if (client.CurrentState == FrameSyncClient.State.Syncing) {
            // SILENT WHEN IDLE: only send when player has actual input
            if (HasPlayerInput()) {
                byte[] input = GatherInput();  // WASD, mouse, actions
                client.SendInput(input);
                ApplyInput(client.PlayerId, input);  // LOCAL-FIRST: execute immediately
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Template B: Entity Authority Sync (Open World/Racing)

```csharp
using BoomNetwork.Client.FrameSync;

// Step 1: Implement IEntitySync on your networked object
public class NetworkPlayer : MonoBehaviour, IEntitySync {
    public int EntityId { get; set; }
    public int StateSize => 24;  // 3 floats position + 3 floats rotation

    public int WriteState(byte[] buf, int off) {
        // Authority player: serialize current state
        BitConverter.TryWriteBytes(buf.AsSpan(off), transform.position.x);
        BitConverter.TryWriteBytes(buf.AsSpan(off + 4), transform.position.y);
        BitConverter.TryWriteBytes(buf.AsSpan(off + 8), transform.position.z);
        // ... rotation ...
        return StateSize;
    }

    public void OnRemoteState(byte[] data, int off, int len, int senderPid) {
        // Remote player: apply received state with smoothing
        float x = BitConverter.ToSingle(data, off);
        float y = BitConverter.ToSingle(data, off + 4);
        float z = BitConverter.ToSingle(data, off + 8);
        transform.position = Vector3.Lerp(transform.position, new Vector3(x, y, z), 0.3f);
    }
}

// Step 2: Register with client
void OnSpawnLocalPlayer(NetworkPlayer player) {
    player.EntityId = client.PlayerId;  // use playerId as entityId
    client.RegisterAuthorityEntity(player);
}

// Step 3: Listen for remote entity states
client.OnEntityState += (senderPid, entityId, data, offset, len) => {
    if (remoteEntities.TryGetValue(entityId, out var entity))
        entity.OnRemoteState(data, offset, len, senderPid);
};

// SendInput or SendAuthorityEntityStates flushes all registered entity states automatically
```

### Template C: State Sync Only (Chat/Social/Casual)

```csharp
// No frame sync needed — just rooms + message broadcasting
var client = new FrameSyncClient();

client.OnConnected += () => client.MatchRoom(8, "lobby");
client.OnReady += () => {
    // Do NOT call RequestStart — no frame sync
    client.SetData(1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("PlayerName"));  // persistent KV
};

// Receive broadcasts
client.OnStateMessage += (pid, data) => UpdateRemotePosition(pid, data);
client.OnDataChanged  += (ver, pid, key, val) => UpdatePlayerInfo(pid, key, val);
client.OnDataSynced   += (ver, entries) => RebuildAll(entries);

// Send position (only when changed — Silent When Idle)
if (positionChanged)
    client.SendStateMessage(EncodePosition(myPos));

// Custom game messages
client.SendGameMessage(gameCmd: 100, data: myPayload);
client.OnGameMessage += (cmd, senderPid, data, off) => HandleGameMsg(cmd, senderPid, data);
```

---

## 5. Common Mistakes (AI MUST avoid these)

### WRONG: Processing own input in OnFrame
```csharp
// BAD — causes double execution of local input
client.OnFrame += frame => {
    foreach (var input in frame.Inputs)
        ApplyInput(input.PlayerId, input.DataSpan);  // includes self!
};
```

### CORRECT: Skip own input in OnFrame (Local-First)
```csharp
// GOOD — local input already executed in Update()
client.OnFrame += frame => {
    foreach (var input in frame.Inputs)
        if (input.PlayerId != client.PlayerId)
            ApplyInput(input.PlayerId, input.DataSpan);
};
```

### WRONG: Sending input every frame regardless
```csharp
// BAD — violates Silent When Idle, wastes bandwidth
void Update() {
    client.Tick(dt);
    client.SendInput(GatherInput());  // sends even when player does nothing!
}
```

### CORRECT: Only send when player has actual input
```csharp
// GOOD — silent when idle
void Update() {
    client.Tick(dt);
    if (client.CurrentState == FrameSyncClient.State.Syncing && HasInput()) {
        byte[] input = GatherInput();
        client.SendInput(input);
        ApplyLocalInput(input);
    }
}
```

### WRONG: Modifying game state outside OnFrame
```csharp
// BAD — causes desync between players
async void OnPowerUpCollected() {
    playerHP += 50;  // async mutation outside OnFrame = desync!
}
```

### CORRECT: All shared state changes inside OnFrame
```csharp
// GOOD — encode event as input, process deterministically in OnFrame
void OnPowerUpCollected() {
    pendingActions.Enqueue(Action.Heal50);  // queue it
}
byte[] GatherInput() {
    // include pending actions in input packet
}
// In OnFrame: all players process the same action at the same frame
```

### WRONG: Using prediction/rollback concepts
```csharp
// BAD — BoomNetwork has no rollback. Never write this.
client.Predict(input);
client.Rollback(frame);
client.Reconcile();
```

### CORRECT: Self-authority model
```csharp
// GOOD — own input is truth, remote input is trusted, no rollback
ApplyLocalInput(input);      // immediate, authoritative
// In OnFrame:
ApplyRemoteInput(remote);    // trusted, no verification needed
```

---

## 6. Server Configuration (config.yaml)

```yaml
# Network
addr: ":9000"              # game server listen address
protocol: "tcp"            # "tcp" or "kcp"

# Frame sync
frameRate: 20              # ticks per second (20 = 50ms per frame)
frameBufferSize: 2400      # ring buffer size (frames), determines max reconnect window
snapshotIntervalFrames: 100  # pushed to client, client uploads snapshot every N frames
quickReconnectMaxMs: 5000    # pushed to client, fast-reconnect timeout

# Room
maxPlayersPerRoom: 4       # default max players
disconnectKeepSec: 120     # how long to keep disconnected player's slot

# Admin
adminAddr: ":9091"         # admin HTTP + WebSocket
adminToken: ""             # auth token for admin endpoints (empty = no auth)
```

### Admin HTTP Endpoints
```
GET  /health              # health check
GET  /stats               # traffic + room stats
GET  /rooms               # room list with player counts
GET  /rooms/inspect/{id}  # deep room inspection
POST /rooms/{id}/kick/{pid}  # kick player
POST /rooms/{id}/stop     # force stop room
POST /netsim              # set network simulation (delay/jitter/loss)
GET  /netsim              # get current netsim settings
POST /config/reload       # hot-reload config
POST /loglevel            # change log level at runtime
```

---

## 7. Project Structure

```
BoomNetwork/
├── svr/                          # Go server
│   ├── cmd/framesync/main.go     #   entry point + admin + config
│   ├── framesync/room.go         #   room tick loop + frame ring buffer
│   ├── framesync/protocol.go     #   protocol definitions
│   ├── codec/                    #   binary message codec
│   ├── transport/                #   TCP + KCP listeners
│   └── session/                  #   message routing
├── cli/                          # C# client library (.NET 8)
│   ├── Core/                     #   protocol, codec, IEntitySync
│   ├── Client/                   #   FrameSyncClient, ConnectionManager, Room, Reconnect
│   └── Tests/                    #   NUnit tests
├── unity/com.boom.boomnetwork/   # Unity UPM package
│   ├── Runtime/                  #   mirrors cli/ as Unity asmdef
│   └── Samples~/                 #   8 progressive demos
└── doc/                          # documentation
```

## 8. UPM Package Installation

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "com.boom.boomnetwork": "https://github.com/luwenyiCC/BoomNetwork.git?path=unity/com.boom.boomnetwork#dev1.0"
  }
}
```

Optional GM tools package:
```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "com.boom.boomnetwork.gm": "https://github.com/luwenyiCC/BoomNetwork.git?path=unity/com.boom.boomnetwork.gm#dev1.0"
  }
}
```
